text:
STEP 1 - Scene: A home-style dinner of two breaded/crusted chicken pieces, one of them a stuffed breast with an oat/nut crumble topping and dried cranberries/blueberries, served with an arugula salad.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A square white dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. I treat it as about 600 cm² because it is square.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Crusted chicken piece (left)
- Chicken with crumble topping and berries (right)
- Arugula salad with slivered almonds and blueberries
- Vinaigrette dressing (light, visible sheen on the leaves)

STEP 4 - Area:
- Left chicken: 8%
- Right chicken with topping: 17%
- Arugula: 35%
- Total covered: about 60%

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Left chicken: 48 cm² × 2.5 cm = 120 ml
- Right chicken: 102 cm² × 2.5 cm = 255 ml
- Arugula: 210 cm² × 3 cm = 630 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Left chicken: 120 ml × 0.9 = 108 g
- Right chicken: 255 ml × 0.8 (crumbly topping) = 204 g
- Arugula: 630 ml × 0.12 = 76 g
- Almonds and blueberries in the salad: about 10 g
- Dressing: about 10 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Breaded chicken: 108 g × 230 kcal/100 g = 248 kcal
- Crumble-topped chicken: 204 g × 220 kcal/100 g = 449 kcal
- Arugula: 76 g × 25 kcal/100 g = 19 kcal
- Almonds and berries: 10 g × 300 kcal/100 g = 30 kcal
- Dressing: 10 g × 450 kcal/100 g = 45 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is about 408 g and 791 kcal. That is plausible for a hearty chicken plate with salad.
